AaveV3InstancesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Aave V3 instance. Supersedes AaveV3_Base, disabled below.

MorphoMarketsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Morpho Blue market. Supersedes MorphoMarket_* adapters, disabled below.

BalancerV3PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): wallet-held Balancer V3 LP. Supersedes BalancerV3_GHO_USDC pool legs, disabled below.

BalancerV3GaugesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): gauge-staked Balancer V3 LP + rewards. Supersedes BalancerV3_GHO_USDC gauge legs, disabled below.

FluidFTokensMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Fluid fToken. Supersedes Fluid_fToken_* adapters, disabled below.

CompoundV3CometsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Compound V3 comet. Supersedes CompoundV3_* adapters, disabled below.

PancakeSwapV3PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): PancakeSwap V3 pools via on-chain NFT enumeration. Registered via addMetaBalanceAdapter + addMetaInstances when enabled. Disabled: COW on Base has no feed. Enable + add pool instances (both tokens must be registered) once COW is priced.
